title: Canadair CL-415 消防水陸飛機
subcategoryTitle: 民航機與世界航空案例
subcategoryTitleEn: Civil aircraft and world aviation cases
summary: 以CL-415消防水陸機類型討論水載荷、重心、浮力與循環能量；只做桌上質量能量模型，不提供取水、投水或消防飛行指示。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
summaryEn: Use the CL-415 firefighting-amphibian type to discuss water payload, centre of gravity, buoyancy and cycle energy solely through desktop models, excluding scooping, dropping or firefighting-flight instructions. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

steps.title: 水陸構型的浮力：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Buoyancy of an amphibious configuration: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 水陸構型的浮力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Buoyancy of an amphibious configuration and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 排水體積乘流體密度與重力得到浮力；平衡重量不代表橫向穩定或滑水性能。
steps.instructionEn: Displaced volume times fluid density and gravity gives buoyancy; balancing weight does not establish lateral stability or planing performance.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非Canadair CL-415 消防水陸飛機實際性能或製程：ρwater=1000 kg/m³，排水體積V=0.8 m³。式 Fb=ρgV，基準結果 7848 N。適用條件：靜水完全已知排水量，非水面起降或操作方法。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Canadair CL-415 firefighting amphibian: Water density=1000 kg/m³ and displaced volume V=0.8 m³. Formula Fb=ρgV gives 7848 N. Conditions: Static water with known displacement, not water takeoff/landing procedures.
steps.failure: 只核對總浮力但忽略偏載，仍可能不具穩定回復力矩。
steps.failureEn: Matching total buoyancy while ignoring asymmetric loading may leave inadequate restoring moment.
steps.check: 在虛擬截面比較吃水與排水體積，另標重心與浮心位置。
steps.checkEn: Compare draft and displaced volume in a virtual section and mark centre of gravity and buoyancy separately.

knowledge.title: 水陸構型的浮力
knowledge.text: 排水體積乘流體密度與重力得到浮力；平衡重量不代表橫向穩定或滑水性能。

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先預測方向，再只把V改成0.9 m³；其餘條件固定。模型結果由 7848 改為 8829 N。在算式區重算並記下對「水陸構型的浮力」的判讀，以及仍需要哪個量測才能檢驗假設。
knowledge.textEn: Predict the direction, then Change only displaced volume to 0.9 m³, holding other conditions fixed. The model changes from 7848 to 8829 N. Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Buoyancy of an amphibious configuration, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.

steps.title: 水載量變化與重心：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Changing water payload and centre of gravity: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 水載量變化與重心 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Changing water payload and centre of gravity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 重心是質量加權位置，增加設備的影響取決於質量和力臂；總重量與重心必須同時計算。
steps.instructionEn: Centre of gravity is a mass-weighted position; added equipment depends on mass and arm, so total mass and centre of gravity must be tracked together.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非Canadair CL-415 消防水陸飛機實際性能或製程：m1=1000 kg、x1=2 m；m2=200 kg、x2=4 m。式 xcg=Σmixi/Σmi，基準結果 2.33333333 m。適用條件：單軸固定基準教學模型，沒有提供任何機型重心限制。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Canadair CL-415 firefighting amphibian: m1=1000 kg at x1=2 m and m2=200 kg at x2=4 m. Formula xcg=Σmixi/Σmi gives 2.33333333 m. Conditions: Single-axis fixed-datum teaching model without aircraft-specific centre-of-gravity limits.
steps.failure: 只在質量表加入物件卻忘了力矩，或混用不同基準會使重心錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Adding mass without moment or mixing datums corrupts the centre-of-gravity result.
steps.check: 先固定基準與正方向，核對所有配載是否包含在質量和力矩兩張表。
steps.checkEn: Fix datum and sign first and verify every item appears in both mass and moment ledgers.
